# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream rendering corrections. Linux applications that rely on a particular font fallback face should review the changed fontconfig selection behavior.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback can select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path. Applications that require deterministic fallback glyphs or metrics should specify an explicit family and style or bundle the required typeface.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Brings the 4.153 preview line to the Chrome m153 renderer. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))
- **Upstream m153 rendering fixes adopted** — Includes Chrome m153 correctness, bug-fix, and buffer-upload updates in the bundled engine. ([#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

Improves the native HarfBuzz build's warning handling without changing the managed HarfBuzzSharp API.
